## B — Audience, Lane usage, turning, changing lanes and roundabouts

The audience is first-time, never-licensed applicants for a Michigan operator's license, reading at a plain-English level, plus newcomers and parents of teen drivers who use the same handbook. This section covers keeping right and its exceptions on ordinary roads and freeways, illegal weaving and median crossing, turn signals and hand signals, right and left turn technique including multiple turn lanes, changing lanes, roundabouts from approach to exit, and the opening railroad crossing rules. It teaches when a driver may leave the right lane, how to make right and left turns and lane changes, how to enter, travel and exit a roundabout, and how far to stop from railroad tracks. It assumes no prior driving knowledge and no prerequisites beyond literacy, so wording stays concrete, procedural and free of legal jargon throughout.
